architecture.summary: The inventory has strong Monstera and problem-guide clusters but only one usable plant profile, no effective plant-first category taxonomy, several broken technical or navigational paths, and seven orphaned paths. Build navigation around plant profiles, problem guides, care guides and tools, subject to human review for taxonomy, placeholders and technical URLs.

strategy.summary: No ranking-based prioritisation is available because Search Console rows are empty. Build around the existing Monstera cluster, rescue genuine orphans through relevant hubs, and review broken navigation and missing plant hubs before expanding links. Placeholder and broken paths are excluded as pillars and targets.
principles: Use contextual text hyperlinks in natural article sentences, not generic related-link boxes.
Prioritise plant-profile ↔ care/problem reciprocity and symptom-to-care journeys.
Use only exact live inventory paths for approved links; exclude placeholders and broken paths.
Do not create unrelated cross-plant links or filler links.
Target at least three relevant contextual outgoing links and one relevant inbound link per genuine article; where inventory cannot support this honestly, review a missing plant profile or hub.
